name: Toxic Brazier Trap (CR 5)
body:
Toxic Brazier Trap
CR 5

Type mechanical Perception DC — (sprung); Disable Device DC 20

EFFECTS

Trigger — (already sprung); Reset none
Effect multiple targets (all targets in room; never miss); poison (ungol dust – see below)

Ungol Dust

Type poison (inhaled); Save Fortitude DC 15
Frequency 1/round for 4 rounds
Initial Effect 1 Cha drain; Secondary Effect 1d2 Cha damage; Cure 1 save

Once the trap is disabled, its vapors quickly dissipate, decreasing the ungol dust poison’s DC by -1 per round in all affected areas, until 15 rounds pass and the threat is entirely gone.
